messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: legend
parts:
On Mon, Aug 16, 2010 at 01:01:35PM -0700, steve wrote:
> do you think it is possible to increase the legend box size ? i
> want to elongate the line so that the line type can be seen clearly.

you can increase the legend.key.size, but unfortunately width and height
can not be set to different values, so the following example is a bit
ugly:

ggplot(mtcars,aes(disp,hp,linetype=factor(gear))) +
geom_line() + opts(legend.key.size=unit(4.5,"lines"))


regards,
stefan
